spec_match.rationale: Profiles four genuinely different workloads with a real Profiler and shows the stack-only traces cannot be told apart — the motivation for markers.

interactive.rationale: "Profile all four" produced per-workload samples/frames and a 6-pair comparison; "Clear" reset it.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the motivation angle on the index.

edge_cases.rationale: Does not re-run the comparison with markers enabled to show them becoming distinguishable.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/<id> in the see-also block plus the spec/explainer.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite shows 1 PASS / 5 FAIL because /v153/js-self-profiling-markers/conformance/ is served WITHOUT Document-Policy: js-profiling (routes/conformance.ts only special-cases v147), so even profiler construction fails; the concept pages themselves do carry the header.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass): 208 samples, 1 distinct leaf-frame set across 4 workloads; console clean; not a chrome-devtools-mcp/Canary pass, and no accessibility-tree inspection.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry is loaded and the page records named assertions for its main measurement; no unexpected errors seen.

design_system.rationale: Inline styles use the design-system variables; button overrides keep text/background pairs readable; not a static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native, labelled controls (no unnamed controls found), visible focus on a Tab walk, and results surfaced as text in status/output regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360×740 documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth (wide content scrolls inside its own container) and desktop 1280×800 lays out cleanly.

openQuestions.title: Add the "with markers" column when the field is present
openQuestions.detail: When samples carry marker, compute the per-workload marker distribution so the page shows the same four workloads becoming distinguishable (gc vs layout vs style), closing the loop on its own argument.

summary: Critique-only pass. Loaded http://localhost:3109/v153/js-self-profiling-markers/indistinguishable-profiles/ in Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass), clicked/changed every visible control, captured console errors and failed requests, checked 360px horizontal overflow and a Tab focus walk, and ran /v153/js-self-profiling-markers/conformance/ (unflagged, and with the relevant --enable-blink-features flag where one exists). Non-minor work items are listed in openQuestions. Fix pass (goal-setting, 2026-11-15): verified in Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass) against a local server, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch, with and without the relevant --enable-blink-features flag; every visible control clicked/tapped, 0 horizontal overflow, no console errors. Added the ExperimentalJSProfilerMarkers banner (status experimental, origin_trial_feature_name JSSelfProfilingMarkers in runtime_enabled_features.json5 for tag 153.0.8010.12 and main).
